title: [Bug] Unexpectedly High API Usage and Rate Limit Hits
body:
**Bug Description**
The usage this week was absurdly high, I've hit limits much faster than before, I've read I'm not the only one and that it's caused by bugs

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 2.1.87
- Feedback ID: 42960fb3-fb3b-4b74-bc76-c8656ba90099

top_comments.body:
I've been experiencing the same issue on Max 20 ($200/mo) — rate limit 100% exhausted in ~70 minutes.

After setting up a monitoring proxy using the official `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` env var, I identified two cache bugs as the root cause ([#40524](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40524), [#34629](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/34629)) and measured the impact: **cache read ratio dropped to 4.3%**, meaning ~20x token inflation per turn.
